action.objective: Verify Nxe4 as the best continuation, keeping the knight active and resolving Black's d4 pawn pressure.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search over all legal moves suggested c3e4 (score 28, exact) via Nxe4 Bxe4 dxe4. This trades the light-squared bishop for the knight, opening the d-file/diagonal and giving White a central pawn on e4. Before committing, run a single-candidate verification at max depth to confirm no tactical refutation and check all Black replies.
